Messages.Author: Blooded Sand
Messages.Body:
Red List: Any Methuselah may use a master phase action to mark a Red
List minion for the current turn. Any ready vampire she controls may
enter combat with a marked Red List minion as a +1 stealth (D) action
that costs 1 blood.
***Each vampire can take this action only once each turn.***
-snip-

Emphasis mine

If I have 2 master phase actions, may I mark 2 different Red List
minions, and enter combat with them each once with the same miinion?
